title: Fast Enumeration of Minimal Removable Sets in Monotone Systems with Application to Core Collapse Analysis
summary: In network vulnerability analysis, it is crucial to evaluate the robustness of $k$-cores against vertex removals. A $k$-core is often fragile since removing a few vertices can trigger a large reduction in the core size, a phenomenon known as core collapse. In this paper, we study the problem of enumerating all minimal removable sets (MinRSs) of a given $k$-core, where a MinRS is a minimal nonempty set of vertices whose removal results in a smaller $k$-core graph.
